description: Phase 1 — DB + backend foundation. Additive products inventory columns + six new POS tables via runtime ensure*() in dataImport.ts (mirrored Prisma models + manual .sql), startup wiring, public-catalog leakage guard, extraction of shared session helpers, phone allowlist + phone-OTP auth, and the new RBAC permission keys. This is the base every later feature depends on. Grounded in: dataImport.ts ensure* pattern, server.ts app.listen wiring, auth/middleware.ts RBAC, routes/users.ts module-private session helpers, routes/catalog.ts findMany/findUnique leak, routes/admin.ts ALLOWED_PERMS, routes/otp.ts devOtp pattern.
steps: api-node/package.json: run `npm install` first (worktree has NO node_modules).

api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts: add ensureProductInventoryColumns() — information_schema-guarded ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN for sku VARCHAR(64), barcode VARCHAR(64), purchase_price DECIMAL(10,2), stock DECIMAL(10,3) DEFAULT 0.000, unit VARCHAR(12) DEFAULT 'pcs', tax_rate DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00, low_stock_threshold DECIMAL(10,3), track_inventory TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, allow_negative_stock TINYINT(1); each swallows MySQL 1060; add non-unique idx_products_sku, idx_products_barcode. Mirror ensureMasterPasswordColumn style exactly.

api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts: add ensurePosSettingsColumns() for the §2.3 settings columns (pos_allow_negative_stock, pos_sale_notifications, pos_bill_prefix, pos_next_bill_seq, pos_allow_manual_items), swallow 1060; seed store_address default if blank.

api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts: add ensurePosTables() with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (InnoDB utf8mb4) for pos_bills, pos_bill_items, stock_movements, admin_phones, pos_import_batches, product_change_log and all indexes per design §2.2. Follow ensureMarketingTables() style.
api-node/prisma/: add pos-inventory.sql, pos-settings.sql, pos-tables.sql as the manual equivalents.

api-node/prisma/schema.prisma: add models PosBill, PosBillItem, StockMovement, AdminPhone, PosImportBatch, ProductChangeLog (@@map snake_case) with the runtime-created comment; add the inventory fields to the existing Product model. Do NOT run prisma migrate/db push/generate.

api-node/src/server.ts: import and call ensureProductInventoryColumns, ensurePosSettingsColumns, ensurePosTables fire-and-forget with .catch(console.error) AFTER ensureMarketingTables in the app.listen callback.

api-node/src/routes/catalog.ts: define one PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT allow-list and apply `select` to BOTH GET /api/products (findMany) AND GET /api/products/:id (findUnique); exclude purchase_price, low_stock_threshold, allow_negative_stock, track_inventory; audit other prisma.product reads in routes/ and seo/.

api-node/src/auth/session.ts: create and MOVE issueTokens, safeUser, toClaims, isMobileClient (+ cookieOpts, REFRESH_COOKIE, ACCESS_COOKIE) out of routes/users.ts, exporting them; re-point routes/users.ts to import them so the login response shape is byte-for-byte unchanged.

api-node/src/routes/pos-auth.ts: create POST /api/pos/auth/otp/send and /verify (PUBLIC, zod ^[6-9]\d{9}$ / ^\d{6}$; OTP in emailOtp purpose='pos_login', email='pos:<mobile>'; enumeration-safe generic 200; devOtp in non-prod; delivery via tokensForStaff+sendToTokens; rate-limit via utils/rateLimit.ts; verify upserts user by mobile to role owner|admin + permissions and calls shared issueTokens, returning the exact /api/users/login shape).

api-node/src/routes/admin-pos.ts: create GET/POST /api/admin/pos/phones and DELETE /api/admin/pos/phones/:mobile (requireOwner); upsert admin_phones + sync matching user role/permissions; on delete set active=0, demote user to customer, revoke their refresh tokens; 409 on self-removal.
api-node/src/server.ts: mount admin-pos BEFORE generic /api/admin (like admin-links) and pos-auth under /api/pos/auth.

api-node/src/__tests__/: add a minimal node:test harness and the §10 public-catalog leakage shape test asserting neither /api/products nor /products/:id payload carries purchase_price/low_stock_threshold/allow_negative_stock/track_inventory.
acceptance_criteria: `npm --prefix ...\api-node run build` produces ONLY new prisma.<posModel> delegate-missing errors (expected) and no other new tsc error.
server.ts calls the three new ensure* functions fire-and-forget after ensureMarketingTables.
PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT is applied to both GET /api/products and GET /api/products/:id and the leakage test passes.
issueTokens/safeUser/toClaims/isMobileClient live in auth/session.ts and routes/users.ts imports them with unchanged login behaviour.
/api/pos/auth/* and /api/admin/pos/phones exist, are server-side guarded (requireOwner / public login), and ALLOWED_PERMS includes pos/inventory/pos_reports.
verification: Run `npm --prefix c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing\4astore-v2\api-node install` then `npm --prefix ...\api-node run build`; confirm only expected prisma delegate errors.
Run the new catalog leakage test (node:test) and confirm it passes.
findings:
Phase-1 foundation complete. KEY FILES/SYMBOLS for later features:

SHARED SESSION HELPERS — api-node/src/auth/session.ts exports: issueTokens(res,user,deviceLabel?), safeUser(user), toClaims(user), isMobileClient(req), cookieOpts(maxAgeMs), REFRESH_COOKIE, ACCESS_COOKIE. routes/users.ts now imports these (login/register/social-login/refresh response shape unchanged: { user: safeUser(user), token, ...(isMobileClient ? { refreshToken } : {}) }). pos-auth reuses the SAME symbols.

PUBLIC CATALOG GUARD — api-node/src/routes/catalogSelect.ts exports PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT (plain Record<string,true> true-only allow-list, NOT typed as Prisma.ProductSelect because the worktree prisma client is un-generated) and FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_PRODUCT_FIELDS = [purchase_price, low_stock_threshold, allow_negative_stock, track_inventory]. Both GET /api/products and GET /api/products/:id apply `select: PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT`. Public fields kept: stock, unit, tax_rate, sku, in_stock. Any NEW public product read MUST reuse PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT. Staff-guarded reads (marketing /dashboard discountedProducts/lowStock) intentionally still return full rows — that is NOT a public leak. ogShare.ts findUnique uses only name/image/og_image (no leak).

ENSURE* FUNCTIONS — api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts adds & exports ensureProductInventoryColumns(), ensurePosSettingsColumns(), ensurePosTables(); all wired fire-and-forget in server.ts app.listen AFTER ensureShortLinkTables. Products inventory columns: sku, barcode, purchase_price DECIMAL(10,2), stock DECIMAL(10,3) default 0, unit VARCHAR(12) default 'pcs', tax_rate DECIMAL(5,2), low_stock_threshold DECIMAL(10,3), track_inventory TINYINT default 1, allow_negative_stock TINYINT (nullable=inherit global). settings POS columns: pos_allow_negative_stock, pos_sale_notifications (default 1), pos_bill_prefix (default 'INV-'), pos_next_bill_seq (BIGINT UNSIGNED default 1 — bump+read inside checkout tx for bill_no), pos_allow_manual_items (default 1). store_address seeded to romanized live value only when blank.

NEW TABLES (manual SQL: prisma/pos-inventory.sql, pos-settings.sql, pos-tables.sql; Prisma mirror models: PosBill, PosBillItem, StockMovement, AdminPhone, PosImportBatch, ProductChangeLog): pos_bills (bill_no UNIQUE NULL, idempotency_key CHAR(36) UNIQUE NULL, status held|completed|cancelled|refunded, aggregates DECIMAL(12,2)); pos_bill_items (FK bill_id -> pos_bills ON DELETE CASCADE, quantity DECIMAL(10,3), rate/line money, is_manual); stock_movements (append-only, reason sale|cancel_reversal|refund_reversal|import|manual_adjust|bulk_update, change_qty signed, balance_after, bill_no, batch_id); admin_phones (mobile UNIQUE, role owner|staff, permissions JSON, active); pos_import_batches; product_change_log.

AUTH — ALLOWED_PERMS in routes/admin.ts now includes 'pos','inventory','pos_reports' (the SAME trio is duplicated as a local const in pos-auth.ts and admin-pos.ts — keep all three in sync if changed). routes/pos-auth.ts (mounted PUBLIC at /api/pos/auth): POST /otp/send (zod ^[6-9]\d{9}$, rate-limited 5/min bucket 'pos_otp_send', enumeration-safe generic 200, OTP in emailOtp purpose='pos_login' email='pos:<mobile>', devOtp in non-prod, push delivery via tokensForStaff('pos')+sendToTokens) and POST /otp/verify (upserts user by mobile -> owner|admin role + perms, issueTokens, returns login shape). routes/admin-pos.ts (mounted at /api/admin/pos BEFORE generic /api/admin, requireAuth+requireOwner): GET/POST /phones, DELETE /phones/:mobile (sets active=0, demotes user to customer, revokes refresh tokens; 409 on OWNER_MOBILE 7543888698 or self). admin_phones is read/written via raw $queryRawUnsafe/$executeRawUnsafe (table runtime-created).

TEST HARNESS — api-node now has `npm test` = node --import ./src/__tests__/register.mjs --test src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts. register.mjs + loader.mjs transpile .ts on the fly via the installed typescript compiler (no new deps); loader.resolve appends .ts to extensionless relative imports (so test files import '../routes/catalogSelect' WITHOUT extension to satisfy tsc). Leakage test src/__tests__/catalog-leak.test.ts passes (3/3). Reuse this harness for later pure-logic/idempotency tests.

VERIFICATION — `npm run build` emits only the EXPECTED stale/un-generated-prisma-client errors (TS2347 Untyped-function-calls on $queryRawUnsafe<T>, plus the same TS7006/TS2345 already in baseline); no new error of any other class (baseline had 110 TS2347; new ones are the identical signature in admin-pos/pos-auth/catalog/dataImport). Prisma.<posModel> delegates are missing until prisma generate runs on deploy — expected per context.json.
